Class SimulationControlPanel

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
org.swarmforge.client.ui.SimulationControlPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class SimulationControlPanel extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Advanced Simulation Control and Scenario Manager Panel.

Structured strict scenario ordering: 1. Preset du Monde (Biotope / World Preset) 2. Preset Météo (Weather invalid input: '&' Climate Profile) 3. Dynamic Multi-Species invalid input: '&' Ecosystem Scenario Configuration List: - Choice of species to add - Filtered nest types per species - Nest placement strategy invalid input: '&' Pre-generation options - Biologically filtered accessory species (Preys, Predators, Commensals, Pathogens) - Demographics (Workers, Soldiers, Queens) and Caste AI Engines per species - Initial population counts invalid input: '&' Renewal / Replenishment balance strategies for accessories
